text:
maya: Heads-up — seeing spikes of 429s from dedicated reserved-eu-west-1 pool since ~13:04 UTC. Queue length jumping, admission controller is shedding low-priority requests.
oncall-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2025-4321. Auto-alert: reserved-pool-saturation (eu-west-1). Pager duty: @ops-sre
ryan: Any idea what's saturating? model type, seq len, or sudden traffic?
maya: Mostly long-context Gen requests to gptx-34k-quant (customer A) and batchy embeddings. Token rate + KV cache warmups.
linh: Can you paste pool status?
maya: ```
$ rbctl pool status reserved-eu-west-1
pool: reserved-eu-west-1
state: ACTIVE
nodes: 24/24 (maxed)
inflight: 784
queued: 412
avg_latency: 340ms
admission: shedding low-priority
autoscaler: pending-scale (blocked: capacity quota)
```
ops-sre: Autoscaler tried to request +8 instances but hit region GPU quota. Cloud ticket already opened — regional GPU capacity low in eu-west-1.
zach: Is there spare capacity in dedicated-eu-central or hosted fallback?
maya: Hosted fallback exists but customers on Dedicated have routing locked. We can enable emergency routing for affected customers for ~2 hours (requires consent).
ryan: What about admission policy tweaks? Lower per-request concurrency? lower max_tokens?
linh: We can drop concurrency per model from 8->4 and force token cap 8k for that customer. Will reduce perf but avoids 429s.
maya: Doing a quick config push now — will also enable prefix caching TTL to cut repeated KV cost.
ops-sre: Pushing change — patch:
``` 
PATCH /pools/reserved-eu-west-1/admission
{ "concurrency_max":4, "priority_threshold":"high" }
```
maya: Done. Immediate queued drop from 412 -> ~210 seen in metrics.
oncall-bot: Deploy bot: config change applied to reserved-eu-west-1 (rev r1256) by maya.
zach: Great. Still see some 429s from older requests in flight, but falloff starting.
maya: I'm opening a routing exception for customer A to hosted for read-only/test traffic. @zach can you confirm billing/consent?
zach: Confirmed with account team — emergency routing OK for 2 hours. I'll flip the route in 5m.
ryan: Ops note: This will increase hosted costs significantly — we should track delta.
ops-sre: Cloud ticket update: requesting quota increase but AWS reports limited availability for A100/RTX in region for 24-48h.
maya: Monitoring dashboard: token-rate reduced 28%, 429 rate down 75% in last 20m.
linh: Queue length now 82 and stable.
maya: We'll keep emergency routing until autoscaler can add nodes or traffic decreases. Reopening after-action for capacity planning: reserved pool headroom must be >=20% or automatic routing should be allowed.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2025-4321 updated — mitigation in progress. Current severity: P2.
zach: Will follow up with sales + infra for quota/commit options. I'll open a postmortem if we don't hit headroom by EOD.
maya: Thanks all. continuing to monitor, will update if degradation returns.
